description: This file defines the interface QueryBuilderFactory which provides factory methods for creating QueryBuilder instances with or without limits, based on provided Criteria objects.

classes.name: QueryBuilderFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating QueryBuilder instances with specified criteria, either with or without limits.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new QueryBuilder with specified criteria, throws NullPointerException if criteria is null.

methods.name: newUnlimitedBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new QueryBuilder without a default limit for streaming, throws NullPointerException if criteria is null.
